steps.what: Validate environmental assessment data and define report tables, charts and sketches
Produce specified tables and charts and assemble the environmental report draft
Interpret assessment results, prepare necessary sketches and check the complete report
outputs: checked environmental assessment report for engineer review

tasks.design: Configure linked tables, charts and report sections in existing {SPREADSHEET} and {DOCS}. The technician validates the data, writes interpretation, prepares nonstandard sketches and checks the report before the existing engineer review; no model-generated environmental conclusion is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated table preparation and document assembly may require copying data.
tasks.enabler_now: Test-data software can record measurements and produce reports, and native document links can serve simpler cases.
tasks.still_hard: Explain incomplete sampling and distinguish measured results from environmental conclusions.

ambition.what: Refresh a checked report when a comparable new measurement batch is available.

tasks.altitude: Own report traceability and technical interpretation.

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and generates PDF or Word reports; it does not establish automated environmental judgement or measured labour savings.
The proposed report assembly shares and savings are unmeasured assumptions.

assumptions: The technician produces sample ID, location, collection date, parameter, value, unit, method, quality flag, source and chart grouping in s1; its 35 hours includes extraction, capture and validation.
Laboratory or field staff produce underlying measurements through the existing sampling process; no additional measurement work is assumed free.
Missing units, uncertain quality or unsupported layout requests return to manual preparation.
Test native report configuration before writing an integration.
Seven focal and two other-role hours per 100 baseline hours cover template checks, definition changes and source support.
Engineer review remains in the existing downstream process and earns no saving; this task stops at a checked draft.
unknowns: Repeatability of layouts and measurement schemas
research_questions: Can native linked reports remove copying after technician validation and engineer review remain?

already_counted.description: Dataset capture, validation and report specification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65; gross 35 minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 28%. Range 0-20% allows nonstandard reports and data cleanup; already generated reports save zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain process parameters and evaluate anomalies

steps.what: Maintain process parameters and evaluate anomalies against actual equipment and site conditions

tasks.design: Retain process assessment and authorized parameter work with the technician under existing engineering direction. {OPS_SYSTEM} indications and {DOCS} support investigation without assuming a new automatic control or diagnosis system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Anomalies need contextual investigation and may involve unreliable measurements.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish instrument faults from process changes and choose an appropriate response.
tasks.human_edge: Connect equipment behavior with site conditions.
tasks.altitude: Own accurate anomaly assessment within existing authority.

evidence.claim: Process anomaly evaluation retains full human investigation time in this design.

assumptions: No validated sensor feed, control logic or automatic fault diagnosis is established.
The technician acts within existing engineering authority and escalates other changes.
Existing controls remain unchanged; no new automation upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Process type, instrumentation and parameter authority
research_questions: Which repeated information-gathering actions occur before necessary on-site anomaly investigation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Investigation and authorized parameter work retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Source products and order inventory materials

steps.what: Obtain product information and identify suppliers that meet technical and inventory requirements
Confirm product suitability and order materials within existing purchasing authority
outputs: authorized materials order or purchase request

tasks.design: Use existing supplier records in {PROCUREMENT} and specifications in {DOCS} to support technical sourcing. The technician confirms suitability and orders through {PARTNER_PORTAL} within current authority; unfamiliar substitutes go through engineering review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Product suitability depends on application details and reliable supplier information.
tasks.enabler_now: Current purchasing catalogues support search without proving technical compatibility.
tasks.still_hard: Validate specifications, compatibility and usable stock needs.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize an apparently similar product that is unsuitable for the process.

evidence.claim: Technical sourcing and suitability decisions remain manual; the digest establishes no validated catalogue or compatibility rules for this process.

assumptions: No recurring identical catalogue purchase or duplicate transcription share is asserted without observation.
Existing search runtime is already software work and earns no labour saving.
Required approvals remain in the current purchasing process; no new purchasing authority is created.
Native purchasing tools remain sufficient, with no new automation upkeep.
research_questions: Are there recurring identical purchases with validated specifications that native catalogue configuration could simplify?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Source assessment and authorized ordering retain full time.

steps.what: Work with customers to assess construction impacts and develop pollution prevention programs

tasks.design: Keep customer discovery, site-specific assessment and prevention choices with the technician under engineering direction. {DOCS} holds project evidence; report assembly is accounted for separately rather than counted again as faster advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Proposed construction and pollution pathways are specific to the site.
tasks.enabler_now: Current project documents support informed discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Identify feasible prevention measures and explain trade-offs.
tasks.human_edge: Understand customer constraints while preserving technical accuracy.

evidence.claim: Customer-specific environmental assessment and prevention planning retain full judgement and discussion time.

assumptions: This task owns consultation and assessment judgement; generated report tables belong to the separate report task.
Recommendations remain draft input for the existing engineering process.
Use existing documents with no new automation or maintenance workload.
unknowns: Project types and engineering review responsibilities
research_questions: What repeated preparation work exists beyond the separately counted report assembly?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Customer assessment and prevention judgement remain.
